paragraphs.text: By worshipping the calves Jeroboam erected in Israel.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: That is, Joash the son of Jehoahaz.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: In which they committed their idolatry, and which the Lord had commanded to be destroyed De 16:21.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: That is, Hazael and Benhadad his son, 2Ki 13:3. Of Hazael read 2Ki 13:22.
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: His chief purpose is to describe the kingdom of Judah, and how God performed his promise made to the house of David: but in the process he shows how Israel was afflicted and punished for their great idolatry, who though they had now degenerated, yet God both by sending them many prophets and various punishments, called them to him again.
paragraphs.label: g
paragraphs.anchor: of Judah began Jehoash the son

paragraphs.text: Thus they used to call the prophets and servants of God, by whom God blesses his people, as in 2Ki 2:12 meaning that they prospered their country more by their prayers than by force of arms.
paragraphs.label: h

paragraphs.text: That is, toward Syria: so that he not only prophesied with words but also confirmed him by these signs that he would have the victory.
paragraphs.label: i

paragraphs.text: Because he seemed content to have victory against the enemies of God two or three times but did not have the zeal to overcome them continually, and to destroy them completely.
paragraphs.label: k

paragraphs.text: By this miracle God confirmed the authority of Elisha, whose doctrine in his life they contemned, that at this sight they might return and embrace the same doctrine.
paragraphs.label: l

paragraphs.text: That is, until their sins were come to a full measure and there was no more hope of amendment.
